title: Core Implementation
description:
CEO Direction: This is a well-defined, small single-file project with explicit requirements. The task description itself serves as the complete specification (dark theme, 25/5 timing, buttons, mode display, inline CSS/JS). Senior developer should implement directly following the stated requirements. CEO will perform QA review on the completed HTML file.

Original Task: Create a simple pomodoro timer in a single HTML file. Dark theme, 25min work / 5min break, start/pause/reset buttons, shows current mode (Work/Break). Inline CSS and JS only, no frameworks.

criteria.text: Code compiles and runs without errors
